baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence رَءَا ... ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا ... مَصْرِفًا moves from sight through judgment to unavoidable contact and failed redirection.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct perception supplies an indication strong enough to settle ظن as certainty; that certainty projects a fall or encounter whose occurrence is fixed, and the final failed search closes the only remaining directional possibility.

activation_trace.role: Eye or inward perception supplies the direct detection that starts the closure sequence.
The kindled fire supplies the concrete and visibly active object of perception.
Certainty reached after an indication converts seeing into settled expectation.
Falling into a place and the fixing of an occurrence supply unavoidable contact.
Finding or reaching a sought thing frames escape as an attempted search that fails.
Turning something away from a direction supplies the absent outlet and completes the lock.

changed_reading.before: The criminals see the Fire, expect to enter it, and cannot escape.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a staged epistemic lock: visible evidence becomes certainty, certainty becomes fixed contact, and search discovers that no directional remainder is left.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ and وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا ... مَصْرِفًا place acquired culpability beside the failure of capacity and maneuver.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents named by guilt and acquisition reach a state in which neither available means nor tactical alteration can operate. The negation therefore removes agency, not merely a physical doorway.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition and earning supply the agents' accumulated side of the causal relation.
Offense and culpability specify what kind of acquisition defines the agents.
Capacity, means, and sufficiency supply the operational resource denied by the clause.
Maneuver and tactical alteration supply the agency that can no longer change the outcome.

changed_reading.before: They cannot locate a place away from the Fire.
changed_reading.after: Those marked by what they acquired discover that no capacity or maneuver remains with which to alter the state now confronting them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water-plant image is a transport and phase-change system: descent, mixing, drying into fragments, and wind dispersal. Against that field of mobile matter, the focus ayah marks a terminal state in which neither transport nor transformation can redirect the criminals from the Fire.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary water supplies the mobile medium from which the transformation sequence begins.
Descent and settling supply the first directed movement through the material system.
Mixing one thing with another supplies a change of material relation and state.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the fragmentable phase that can be carried elsewhere.
Wind-winnowing and airborne dispersal supply successful removal from an initial place.
Wind and moving air supply the carrier that executes dispersal.
Transfer from one condition to another supplies the transformation that the negated maṣrif now denies.

structural_cues: 18:45 orders descent, mixing, growth, dry fragmentation, and wind dispersal; 18:53 ends with a negated maṣrif.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of material transformations and a final denial of redirection; I treat dispersal as the available routing pole opposed by maṣrif. A live alternative is that 18:45 contributes only ephemerality, not a transport analogy.

changed_reading.before: No escape route can be found.
changed_reading.after: The Fire is the terminal boundary of a pericope full of mobile, transformable matter: here no carrier, fragmentation, or change of state produces removal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure, gathering, inscription, and exhaustive counting construct a complete inventory. The repeated finding construction then yields an asymmetry: every deed is found present, while no diversion is found available.

activation_trace.role: Visible exposure supplies an environment in which concealment has been removed.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies complete subject collection.
An inscription that establishes an obligating judgment supplies the durable record.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration supplies the record's total coverage.
Finding the sought or encountered thing supplies the positive discovery of the deeds.
Intentional action supplies what the inventory returns to its agents.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity make the recorded actions immediately available.
The same finding image, now negated, supplies the absent side of the inventory.
A means of turning away supplies the one item the exhaustive scene does not contain.

structural_cues: The same criminal group appears in 18:49 and 18:53.
18:49 says they found what they had done present; 18:53 says they did not find a diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated agents, repeated finding, and exhaustive presence; I infer a deliberately asymmetric inventory in which evidence exists but exit does not. The live alternative is simple scene succession without a designed inventory contrast.

changed_reading.before: The criminals happen upon an inescapable punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their encounter is the output of an audit architecture: persons and deeds are exhaustively present, while the search for an exculpatory or spatial exit returns empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adopted allies and partners constitute an attempted substitute-support network. The sequence denies helper status, withholds their answer, and replaces connection with a separating trap; the absent maṣrif is therefore social and relational as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Alliance, love, and aid supply the expected protective relation.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the attempted substitution.
A strengthening helper supplies the support role explicitly denied to the misleaders.
Partnership supplies the distributed agency on which the callers had relied.
A returned answer supplies the responsive link whose failure disables the network.
Distance and a widened gap replace the expected closeness of partnership.
Entrapment from which one cannot disengage supplies the relational network's terminal form.
Turning harm away supplies the protective function that no ally or partner performs.

structural_cues: 18:50-52 move from adopted allies and a bad substitute to denied helper status, unanswered partners, and a trap placed between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitute relations, expected aid, failed response, separation, and entrapment; I infer that these actors were also imagined as channels for diverted consequence. Alternatively, their failure may expose false worship without directly functioning as an escape mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No route leads away from the Fire.
changed_reading.after: No outsourced agency remains: every substitute, helper, partner, and responsive link has failed, so consequence cannot be routed through another actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact ص ر ف repetition creates a hinge. Revelation had transferred its address through many exemplary forms, but disputation met that multiplicity; the focus maṣrif is the exhausted opposite, where no further turn can alter the destination.

activation_trace.role: Transferring discourse from form to form supplies the many offered interpretive turnings.
The presented example supplies the repeated forms through which warning was made available.
Twisted contention supplies the human response that consumes variation without yielding redirection.
Turning away from a direction supplies the final possibility that is now absent.

structural_cues: Immediate adjacency pairs the negated noun maṣrif in 18:53 with the positive causative verb ṣarrafnā in 18:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition, varied examples, and disputation; I infer a temporal-ethical contrast between abundant pre-judgment rerouting and absent post-sight rerouting. The repetition could instead be noncausal verbal resonance.

changed_reading.before: At punishment there is no way to turn aside.
changed_reading.after: The missing final turn is set against many earlier communicative turnings: the ayah closes a capacity that revelation had repeatedly opened before certainty arrived.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance and warning are met by dislodging argument, turning away, coverings, and auditory weight. Punishment then stands face-to-face, so the focus sight is not ordinary information but perception restored only when it can no longer support a change of direction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path and truth supplies the earlier directional opportunity.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the eventual mode in which punishment becomes directly perceptible.
Warning that awakens caution supplies information intended to enable action before encounter.
Removing something from its place supplies the attempted argumentative displacement of truth.
Turning one's side away supplies the chosen directional refusal.
A protective covering supplies the obstruction of inward reception.
Weight in the ear supplies the obstruction of warning by hearing.
Direct sight supplies the perception that finally penetrates all prior obstruction.
Certainty after a visible indication supplies cognition that is now decisive but no longer preventive.

structural_cues: 18:55-57 pair arriving guidance and warning with turning away, coverings, and deafness; 18:53 pairs direct sight with certainty and no turning place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earlier directional and perceptual refusal followed by direct sight; I infer that moral refusal hardens into final spatial inability. A live alternative is that the coverings are imposed consequence rather than a self-produced causal trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the Fire makes the criminals realize that encounter is unavoidable.
changed_reading.after: Sight is tragically late: perception becomes certain only after the earlier perceptual and directional capacities that could have changed the course have been refused or blocked.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy explains non-hastening, while appointment fixes a later limit. The near-parallel failed-finding clauses equate the focus maṣrif with the later absent refuge: delay opens time before reckoning but does not create an alternate destination after it.

activation_trace.role: Merciful tenderness supplies the reason immediate seizure is withheld.
Seeking and acquiring an outcome supplies the deeds for which seizure could occur.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the timing explicitly withheld.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the deferred but bounded terminus.
The repeated failed finding supplies a syntactic bridge back to the focus search.
Refuge in a safe place and deliverance resolve the practical content of the absent maṣrif.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized endpoint attached to appointed time.
Fixed falling or occurrence supplies the focus endpoint that the appointment schedules.
The absent turning-away supplies the same no-refuge closure in directional terms.

structural_cues: 18:58 parallels لَن يَجِدُوا ... مَوْئِلًا with 18:53 وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا ... مَصْرِفًا.
18:58 places mercy and non-hastening before an appointed time; 18:59 joins appointed time to destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, withheld acceleration, appointment, and absent refuge; I infer that delay is a mercy-window rather than uncertainty about the endpoint. Alternatively, mercy may explain postponement without making the interval part of 18:53's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Fire is immediately and absolutely inescapable.
changed_reading.after: The closure is absolute at encounter but not arbitrary in timing: mercy had deferred the fixed appointment, and the elapsed interval was delay rather than diversion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates currency exchange in ص ر ف and wealth-capacity in و ج د beyond the immediate spatial syntax. It remains anchored in the focus roots and is sharpened by nearby wealth, returned recompense, and substitution; downstream prose should present it only as an economic analogy, not replace the primary sense of an escape or turning-place.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا, read beside ٱلْمَالُ, ثَوَابًا, and بَدَلًا.

activation_trace.role: Earning and acquisition supply the accumulated position brought into judgment.
Wealth, means, and capacity supply the resources whose availability is negated.
Currency exchange and differential value supply the image of converting one holding into another outcome.
Accumulated wealth supplies the nearby form of worldly capital.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies a contrasting economy of consequences.
One thing replacing another supplies the failed possibility of substitution.

changed_reading.before: They possess no route away from the Fire.
changed_reading.after: Judgment is nonfungible: no accumulated asset, capacity, recompense, or substitute can be converted into an exit.

strongest_changes: The focus search becomes the negative side of an exhaustive accounting system: deeds are found present, but no diversion is found.
The exact ص ر ف hinge contrasts many earlier revelatory turnings with the absence of any final turning after sight becomes certainty.
The absent maṣrif includes collapsed relational support and is temporally clarified by mercy, deferred appointment, and the parallel absence of refuge.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly opens mechanisms of movement, substitution, perception, and delay, then closes each around the focus ayah. This makes inescapability functional rather than merely emphatic.
remaining_uncertainties: ظَنُّوا remains branch-open between certainty after an indication and expectation, although direct sight favors the stronger reading here.
مُّوَاقِعُوهَا can foreground falling into, encountering, or fixed contact; the models retain that range.
The causal arrow from earlier refusal to final inability is inferred from sequence and reversal rather than grammatically asserted.
The nonfungibility outlier is a controlled analogy and should not displace the primary spatial-directional sense.
